skill.name: role-address-filter
skill.description: Flags role and shared inboxes such as info@, sales@ and support@ in a contact list, verifies every address with verify_email, and uses search_people to find a named person at each company behind those inboxes. Returns a cleaned list with honest email labels. Use when someone asks to remove generic inboxes, replace info@ addresses with real people, or find who sits behind sales@ before a campaign.
skill.summary: Flag shared inboxes, check email status with Leadsets, and find named work contacts at the same companies.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The backtick, configuration, and reconnaissance flags are false positives, and the homepage and signup URLs are references. The Leadsets endpoint is an intended external dependency, but the workflow sends unique addresses for verification without requiring approval of the transfer. It also permits CRM writes without a separate confirmation step.

remediation.issue: Contact data is sent to Leadsets without a separate approval step.
remediation.suggestion: Show the destination, fields, and record count before the first transfer. Require explicit approval and offer local flagging or verification of flagged addresses only.

remediation.issue: CRM writes can occur without explicit approval of the changes.
remediation.suggestion: Default to a review file or read-only preview. Before writing, ask the user to approve the destination and the proposed flags or new contacts.

content.user_title: Filter Shared Inboxes and Find Work Contacts
content.value_statement: Shared inboxes in contact lists make it hard to identify a relevant person. Flag shared addresses, check email status, and find named contacts at matching companies.
actual_capabilities: Normalize email addresses, flag exact duplicates, and group shared inboxes by company domain.
Check Leadsets usage limits and estimate the records needed for verification and people search.
Record Leadsets email verification status, confidence, and check date for each address checked.
Search company domains for named contacts by function and seniority, with up to three results per company.
Separate verified contacts, role addresses, unconfirmed addresses, and removed rows into distinct outputs.
limitations: Verification and people search require a Leadsets account and an MCP connection or REST API key.
Large lists may require multiple batches because of Leadsets quotas.
A matching person may not use or manage the shared inbox, and some domains have no suitable match.
The skill does not guess email addresses, send messages, or load contacts into a sequencer.

use_cases.title: Review a Webinar Contact Export
use_cases.description: Identify shared inboxes in an event spreadsheet and separate verified addresses from rows that need follow-up.

use_cases.title: Find Sales Contacts by Company
use_cases.description: Look for a sales or revenue operations contact at companies listed only with a shared email address.

use_cases.title: Prepare a CRM Data Quality Review
use_cases.description: Create a review file of flagged inboxes, duplicates, and suggested contacts before making changes to CRM records.

prompt_templates.title: Flag Shared Addresses
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Review a pasted list without sending data to Leadsets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Flag shared inboxes and exact duplicates in this pasted list. Summarize the counts by domain. Do not call Leadsets or modify the source.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Contact CSV
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: Review verification results without changing the source CSV.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the email column in [CSV]. Show the unique address count and estimated Leadsets usage, then wait for approval. After approval, verify the addresses and keep catch-all and unknown results in a separate file.

prompt_templates.title: Find Contacts by Role
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Use a custom role for a limited set of company domains.
prompt_templates.prompt: Flag shared inboxes in [sheet] and propose a search for one sales or revenue operations director per flagged domain. Wait for approval before sending data to Leadsets. Check company and role alignment, and list domains with no match.

prompt_templates.title: Stage a CRM Cleanup
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Plan a quota-limited cleanup with a separate approval for CRM changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [CRM view] and propose batches within [record budget]. Show the data scope and wait for approval before sending contact data to Leadsets. Put verified contacts, unmatched inboxes, and proposed CRM flags in a review file. Do not write to the CRM.

output_examples.input: Flag shared inboxes in a pasted list and leave the source unchanged.
output_examples.output: Reviewed 42 rows and found three exact duplicates. Of the 39 unique addresses, eight were shared inboxes across six domains. No data was sent to Leadsets.

output_examples.input: Find one finance contact per flagged domain and write the results to separate review files.
output_examples.output: Five company domains were searched. Three named finance contacts had verified email addresses. One result was unconfirmed, and one domain had no match. The original records were unchanged.

best_practices: Approve which addresses may be sent to Leadsets before verification begins.
Test one company domain and confirm the role and seniority before expanding the search.
Review the proposed output in a separate file before approving any CRM writes.
anti_patterns: Treating a catch-all, unknown, or search-only address as verified.
Assuming a named contact owns or monitors the shared inbox.
Using email verification status as proof of permission to contact someone.

faq.question: What input formats can I use?
faq.answer: Use a CSV, Google Sheet, CRM view, or pasted list with an email column. Sheets and CRM views require a connection in your agent.

faq.question: What data is sent to Leadsets?
faq.answer: By default, verification sends all unique email addresses. People search uses flagged company domains and the requested function and seniority.

faq.question: Can I choose which roles to look for?
faq.answer: Yes. Specify the function and seniority, or use the defaults for each inbox type. Request one to three people per company.

faq.question: What happens if there is no verified replacement?
faq.answer: The original inbox remains listed. If a broader search returns an unconfirmed contact, its status stays unchanged. If no person is found, the report says so.

faq.question: How does Leadsets count usage?
faq.answer: Verification uses one enrichment record per email. People search uses one search record per person returned. The usage check is free.

faq.question: Will this change my CRM records?
faq.answer: The workflow can add flags or new contacts through your agent's CRM connection. Choose a separate output to keep CRM records unchanged.
